note: LA.29. The eventbus `publish(` needle (parsers/code/extractors/src/eventbus.rs EMITTER_PATTERNS) matches the first `publish(` anywhere in a file, definitions included, so a Python `def publish(self, ...)` mints event_emit:publish (owned by Notifier::publish via USES). Its conjugate `.subscribe(` does the same for any RxJS observable, minting event_handle:subscribe (orphan nodes in quokka-stack, lapse and neuropil at HEAD). Both verbs now need a bus-shaped receiver or an in-process pub/sub import, and a declaration never counts. The type-keyed `.send(new ` needle (MediatR) also fires on AWS SDK v3 command objects (orders.ts: event_emit:PutItemCommand; fixtures/xcut-queue-annot-listener mints event_emit:SendMessageCommand beside its SQS QUEUE_PRODUCER). posts.ts (graphql-subscriptions PubSub) is the control on both sides. No cells binding: a precision guard.
